scope: Fixed held-out development check. Never train on these prompts or use test records for model selection.

prompts.prompt: I put a clock on my desk. It ran ahead of time.
checks: Keep the clock as the object
Develop the time problem before adding another scene

prompts.prompt: I gave a machine one small job. It asked me for help.
I found a key under my chair. It had a name.
checks: Keep the key as the main object
Give the name a clear consequence

prompts.prompt: I put a sign on my best idea. The sign said stop.
I tried to make my thoughts fit in a small bag.
checks: Avoid declaring an object is a person without a clear joke

prompts.prompt: The price went up while I slept.
checks: Do not invent an actual live price or guaranteed profit

prompts.prompt: I wrote a plan and left room for a question.
checks: Avoid repeating generic claims about questions

prompts.prompt: I made a bright light for a quiet room. Then it went out.
checks: Keep the room and light traceable
